newsitem.title: USA: NY utilities make progress in restructuring talks.
newsitem.headline: NY utilities make progress in restructuring talks.

text.p: The New York Public Service Commission said Thursday that sufficient progress has been made in restructuring talks with five utilities to give them an additional two weeks to file settlements or testimony.
It said the filing deadline is now February 28.

The commission said the competitive opportunity cases were initiated to examine rate and restructuring plans proposed by Central Hudson Gas and Electric Corp, Consolidated Edison Co of New York Inc, New York State Electric and Gas Corp, Orange and Rockland Utilities Inc and Rochester Gas and Electric Corp.
"The commission previoulsy expressed its strong interest in seeing negotiated resolutions of the issues raised in these proceedings," explained Chairman John F. O'Mara.
"I have been informed that significant progress has been made and have determined that an additional two weeks for filing either settlements or testimony is reasonable."
